protocol.objective: Compare original EditScore/EditReward with task-grounded verification on practical attribute editing and replacement requests. Identify natural failures and measure any selection improvement before claiming policy-learning gains.
protocol.candidate_policy: Every initial candidate comes from the same untrained official Qwen-Image-2.1 pipeline. No synthetic degradation.
protocol.labels: Assistant visual review before reading reward scores, not independent human annotations. Preserve per-criterion evidence and uncertainty.
protocol.evaluation: Compare top-1 selection and within-task pair ordering. Freeze task-grounded scoring choices using development sources before inspecting heldout scores. Report ties, failures, and tiny sample limits.
protocol.scope_note: Best-of-N/agent improvements are inference-time improvements and must not be reported as RL weight-training gains.
protocol.retry: One extra four-seed development-only retry with explicit feedback. Evaluated against the original request; not included in heldout top-1 metrics.
protocol.annotation_correction: After heldout inspection, v3 fixes a cream-frame patch which overlapped editable upholstery. Preserve v2 frozen scores separately; report v3 as exploratory annotation-corrected results. No scalar hyperparameters were changed.

summary.evaluation_caveat: After heldout inspection, v3 fixes a cream-frame patch which overlapped editable upholstery. Preserve v2 frozen scores separately; report v3 as exploratory annotation-corrected results. No scalar hyperparameters were changed.
summary.label_source: Assistant visual review, not independent human preference labels.
summary.tie_policy: Lowest seed; all tied winners reported. Pairwise ties receive half credit.

retry_pools.note: Development-only pool with extra generation and feedback; not a heldout policy-training result.
